concerns.text: SC-004 references FR-005 and US-2 as the source of the ‘disclaimer’ requirement, but FR-005 defines gene‑ranking output and US-2 defines fork‑point identification; neither specifies a disclaimer or associational labeling. This cross‑reference is inaccurate and leaves the disclaimer requirement unanchored.

SC-005 cites FR-001 and US-1 as the basis for verifying that the public GEO datasets contain PD‑1 expression, metabolic markers, exhaustion signatures, and therapy‑response labels. FR-001 only mandates downloading the raw count matrices and does not address content validation, so the reference is mismatched.

Success criteria use two different significance thresholds for enrichment analyses: SC-002 and SC-003 require p < 0.01, while SC-006 requires p < 0.05 for the same type of enrichment (fork‑point genes vs. therapy‑response signatures). This inconsistency creates ambiguity about the accepted statistical standard.
